note: Vessel tree, batch 4: the arteries of the foot: medial and lateral plantar arteries, deep plantar artery and plantar arch, plantar and dorsal metatarsal arteries, arcuate artery, and the proper plantar and dorsal digital arteries of every toe. Both sides. Diameters in mm (start, end).

vessels.en: Medial plantar artery
vessels.at: posterior tibial artery, behind the medial malleolus

origin.en: Posterior tibial artery, deep to the flexor retinaculum
origin.zh: 脛後動脈，屈肌支持帶深面

course.en: The smaller terminal branch: runs forwards along the medial side of the sole deep to abductor hallucis and continues along the medial border of the big toe
course.zh: 較細的終支，沿足底內側在拇展肌深面向前，延續為大趾內側緣的固有趾足底動脈

supply.en: Muscles and skin of the medial sole and the big toe
supply.zh: 足底內側的肌肉與皮膚、大趾

vessels.en: Lateral plantar artery
vessels.at: posterior tibial artery, behind the medial malleolus

origin.en: Posterior tibial artery, deep to the flexor retinaculum
origin.zh: 脛後動脈，屈肌支持帶深面

course.en: The larger terminal branch: runs obliquely laterally between flexor digitorum brevis and quadratus plantae to the base of the fifth metatarsal, then curves medially as the plantar arch
course.zh: 較粗的終支，在屈趾短肌與蹠方肌之間斜向外側，到第五蹠骨底，再向內彎成足底弓

supply.en: Muscles of the lateral and central sole and the little toe
supply.zh: 足底外側與中央的肌肉、小趾

vessels.en: Deep plantar artery
vessels.at: dorsalis pedis artery, first interosseous space

origin.en: Dorsalis pedis artery, at the proximal end of the first interosseous space
origin.zh: 足背動脈，第一蹠骨間隙近端

course.en: Dips between the two heads of the first dorsal interosseous muscle into the sole and joins the lateral plantar artery to complete the plantar arch
course.zh: 穿過第一背側骨間肌兩頭之間入足底，與足底外側動脈會合成足底弓

supply.en: Plantar arch; the first plantar metatarsal territory
supply.zh: 足底弓；第一蹠區

vessels.en: Plantar arch
vessels.at: end of the lateral plantar artery

origin.en: Lateral plantar artery (completed medially by the deep plantar artery)
origin.zh: 足底外側動脈（內側由深蹠動脈接成）

course.en: Curves medially across the bases of the metatarsal bones deep to the long flexor tendons and the interossei and joins the deep plantar artery
course.zh: 在長屈肌腱與骨間肌深面橫過蹠骨底向內側，與深蹠動脈會合

supply.en: Plantar metatarsal arteries and the deep muscles of the sole
supply.zh: 足底蹠動脈與足底深層肌肉

vessels.en: Plantar metatarsal artery 1
vessels.at: plantar arch

origin.en: Plantar arch

course.en: Runs forwards in the first interosseous space on the plantar side of the interossei and divides at the cleft between toes 1 and 2
course.zh: 沿第一蹠骨間隙在骨間肌足底側向前，於第1、2趾間分叉

supply.en: Interossei and the adjacent sides of two toes
supply.zh: 骨間肌與相鄰兩趾的相對面

vessels.at: dorsalis pedis artery, over the bases of the metatarsals

course.zh: 在伸肌腱深面橫過第二至第五蹠骨底向外側，分出第二至第四蹠背動脈

supply.en: Dorsal interossei and the dorsum of the lateral toes
